4 charities in Castle Rock, CO lost their 501(c)(3) exemption in the last 18 months -- 29% of every revocation ever recorded there, against 11% nationally. Of the 4 we checked against the IRS's own NTEE code, 2 are direct-service organisations.

Why this caught our eye: the share of a city's all-time direct-service revocations that landed in the last 18 months, at least 1.75x the national share of 11% and at least 4 organisations. A raw count would just rank cities by size. The POPULATION is selected by keywords in the registered name, which over-selects; the organisations NAMED below carry the IRS's own NTEE code so you can tell a homeless shelter from a youth football club without matching on words.

The open question is What actually closed here, and is anything still serving these people? It is settled the other way by: the organisations were dormant or duplicative, or another provider absorbed the work.

Nobody is told what to conclude.
